info.title: RAIT Case commands
info.description: R-0025 admissibility slice per ADR-0041 and UC-RAIT-002. Four operations have typed strict inputs, parent-case If-Match/ETag and idempotency. Other operations retain their existing scope. P4-02-S1 typed scoped replacement of the frozen107-method baseline. ADR0046/47 and T0 closed access/triage maps govern complete role purposes; runtime production qualification is separate. S1 historical scope is retained. P4-02-S2 adds typed claim-context/current-risk reads and the ADR0045/48 selector transport, preserving existing other commands/instances and S1 protections; runtime acceptance and production qualification remain separate.

post.x-rait-scope: Complete S1 role/action/purpose and exact pool/parent scope; ADR0045 selector exception rejects supplied If-Match400, strict empty input and typed CASE result. New defense v+2; qualified legacy defense v+1; other-instance existing v+1 unchanged. Actor-bound retry and all non-claim versioned contracts remain unchanged.
post.description: ADR0045/48/49: strict selector body. Supplied If-Match is rejected400. New defense ADMITIDO v+2; qualified legacy DISTRIBUIDO v+1. Preserve existing other-instance behavior. Actor-bound exact replay reauthorizes current scope without rerunning first-use selection/WIP.
